audits.name: automation_goal_0
audits.type:
∀ (xs : List Nat) (f : Nat → Nat) (p : Nat → Bool) (k cap : Nat),
  (stage_p0 xs f p k).length ≤ cap → (stage_p11 xs f p k).length ≤ cap

audits.name: automation_goal_1
audits.type:
∀ (xs : List Nat) (f : Nat → Nat) (p : Nat → Bool) (k cap : Nat),
  (stage_p2 xs f p k).length ≤ cap → (stage_p11 xs f p k).length ≤ cap

audits.name: automation_combined_buffer_safe
audits.type:
∀ (xs ys : List Nat) (p q : Nat → Bool) (f : Nat → Nat) (k cap : Nat),
  xs.length + ys.length ≤ cap →
    ((List.map f (List.filter p xs)).reverse ++ List.map f (List.take k (List.filter q ys))).length ≤ cap
